purpose: Checks delayed-question recovery, including a deep current value that changes after the first view; not a headline scorecard.

newCases.description: recover a collapsed full-specification value from the target product after the delayed question
control: answer a visible specification after the delayed question; return behavior is informational
recover a current deep shipment-row value after it changes when the question is shown

command: AGENT_SUITE=revisit-v1 AGENT_APPROACHES=mantis,tree,screenshot AGENT_RUNS=1 AGENT_MAX_STEPS=50 AGENT_V2_STANDARD_MAX_STEPS=50 npm run bench:agent
